node: Grid, power-equipment, and permitting execution bottlenecks
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the grid, power-equipment, and permitting execution node. The reference lane is Quanta Services as the obvious grid-construction execution leader. The underfollowed lane prioritizes Powell Industries for medium/low-voltage electrical distribution equipment and substation automation exposure, Atkore for electrical infrastructure products used in data centers and electrification projects, and NV5 Global for utility design, substation engineering, permitting/environmental, geospatial, and conformity-assessment services. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
